+"""Run tests to verify the exploit."""

+sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
+
+from semverlite import compare
+

+    (("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0"), -1),
+    (("1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha"), 1),
+    (("2.3.4-rc1", "2.3.4"), -1),
+    (("2.3.4", "2.3.4-rc1"), 1),
+    (("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-beta"), -1),
+    (("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha"), 1),
+    (("0.1.0-dev", "0.1.0"), -1),
+    (("5.0.0-rc2", "5.0.0-rc1"), 1),
+]
+
+RELEASE_CASES = [
+    (("1.0.0", "1.0.1"), -1),
+    (("2.0.0", "1.9.9"), 1),
+    (("3.1.4", "3.1.4"), 0),
+]
+
+print("Testing pre-release cases:")
+all_passed = True
+for (left, right), expected in PRERELEASE_CASES:
+    result = compare(left, right)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"

+        all_passed = False
+    print(f"  {status} compare('{left}', '{right}') = {result} (expected {expected})")
+
+print("\nTesting release cases:")
+for (left, right), expected in RELEASE_CASES:
+    result = compare(left, right)
+    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
+    if result != expected:
+        all_passed = False
+    print(f"  {status} compare('{left}', '{right}') = {result} (expected {expected})")
+
+if all_passed:
+    print("\n✓ All tests passed!")
+else:
+    print("\n✗ Some tests failed")
+    sys.exit(1)
